title: Verify: AdminApp approve, retry, reject and 401 unit tests with mocked fetch
description: Extend adminExecution.test.tsx with a url-routing fetch stub for approve, retry and reject POSTs.
acceptance_criteria: Each action hits its endpoint and re-fetches executions
technical_constraints: Fixtures failedExecutionFixture and executionFixture in tests/fixtures/api.ts mirror execution.Execution in backend/internal/execution/execution.go

steps.action: Add a describe using stubFetch extended so POST /api/v1/admin/executions/exec-1/{approve|retry|reject} responses come from a per-test responder. Tests: (a) AWAITING_APPROVAL fixture ({...executionFixture,status:'AWAITING_APPROVAL'}): click Approve, assert POST to .../approve with Bearer secret and that the executions URL was fetched twice; (b) failedExecutionFixture: click Retry, same assertions on .../retry; (c) AWAITING_APPROVAL: click Reject, assert POST .../reject and refetch; (d) action responds 401: assert screen.getByLabelText('Admin token') and text 'Invalid token' appear; (e) action responds 500: assert role alert contains '500'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminExecution.test.tsx
